title: The Garden of Ironhollow
author: Petra Dravenmoor
blurb: Jude Pemberton, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
